The Chart of One Member for the Compiled Fifth Order

Source: R/gas_fifth.R
dot-gas_fifth_member.Rd

Returns, for a built score-driven term, the values that the compiled kernels read per row: the level, the loadings, the partial autocorrelations and the cross loadings, each as design rows over the unknowns with its link's derivatives of orders zero to five. .gas_fifth_rows() restricts them to a group's rows and active unknowns.

Usage

.gas_fifth_rows(mem, rows, act)

.gas_fifth_member(tm, psiv, cols, dirs)

Arguments

mem

The result of .gas_fifth_member().

rows, act

A group's rows and active unknowns.

tm

A built score-driven term.

psiv

Its parameters in the order of term_params().

cols

The columns of those parameters among the unknowns.

dirs

The three directions over the unknowns.

Value

A list with vals (named by the layout's slots), p, q, cross (the cross loadings' names), varying_b (whether a partial autocorrelation carries a subformula) and active, the term's coordinates active in each group.
